meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出一条真实电话号码:别人发短信或打 AI 语音电话进来,他能读取并回复;他也能主动用这个号发短信或外呼电话。
howto.when: 当你提出要给代理添加 Dial 真实电话号码(短信 + AI 语音)时触发。

say.text: 给我的智能体加一条 Dial 电话线,用来收发短信和打接 AI 语音电话。
say.note: 触发完整安装,会要求邮箱验证并配对手机。

say.text: 在项目里接入 Dial 电话号码,用于短信和来电。
say.note: 复制适配器和测试,重新构建后注册通道。

say.text: 添加 Dial 通道,并帮我完成号码注册和手机配对。
say.note: 注册后会向手机发送 6 位验证码完成绑定。

howto.what_en: After this skill is applied, Claude gets a real Dial phone number: it can read and reply to incoming texts or AI voice calls, and can initiate texts or calls from that number.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Dial phone number (SMS + AI voice) to your agent.

say_en.text: Add a Dial line to my agent for SMS and AI voice calls.
say_en.note: Runs the full install; asks for email OTP and phone pairing.

say_en.text: Integrate a real phone number into the project via getdial.ai.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and tests, then builds and registers the channel.

say_en.text: Add the Dial channel, then guide me through phone pairing.
say_en.note: Sends a 6-digit SMS code to verify your phone after registration.
